authorization_condition: Execute only if the complete V62 semantic qualification evidence has status PASS and all 14 capabilities pass its locked search-depth, validation-rate, and Wilson gates.

derived_vault.probe_results: new results bound to exact V62 judge observations
derived_vault.inventory: rebuilt from semantic results under unchanged thresholds
derived_vault.budgets: historical survey budgets retained; later composition rebuilds search-only budgets

decision_rule: If V62 full semantic qualification fails, do not build V63.
If V62 passes, derive new probe results without changing any source prompt, response, token ID, finish reason, source manifest, split, or catalog.
Reject construction on any protocol, archive, catalog, judge, runtime, observation, prompt, response, token, or identity mismatch.
Require all 14 inventory entries to remain available after independently rebuilding the inventory.
Write and immediately verify a deterministic source-survey vault and immutable receipt.
Do not call the survey vault a cake or invoke LayerCake from this step.
Only a subsequent segregated search-only composition plus adequacy audit may authorize one LayerCake acquisition run.
failure_attribution: Any V63 construction failure is ABI_ARTIFACT_CONSTRUCTION_FAILURE, never a LayerCake failure.
